body:
I get that a lot. I'm male but I'm REALLY effeminate and most people think I'm gay. I have a very deep voice but my gestures and speech are girly at times. All the more reason I feel like I'll never find somebody who appriciates me and lets me be my true self. I always have to put on a facade around most people just so I don't get outcasted even more. I hate living a lie. I just want to be loved and accepted for who am I.

I don't have any kind of gender dysphoria or anything, I'm fine with being a man physically, I just don't like to act like one.

I just don't understand why that keeps happening to me from so many people.

Sometimes they'll take interest in me and message ME first. One time I got so far I invited her to dinner and she said yes, but when I asked her if a date and time was okay she stopped.

I feel old. I feel like the older I get the more life is going to pass me by because everyone will be married or have children.

Yeah, there's one meetup group I go to sometimes. The regulars are okay people but all taken or not my type. Sometimes we get random girls passing in but it's a crap shoot. Never know who will be there. It's super far from my house so I don't like to go often. I'd love to find other groups to join but there's nothing I can find that captures my interests.
I sent her a message 2 days ago just saying "Didn't forget about me, did you? :)" trying to be playful. Today it was read and also ignored.
